content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Home repair and improvement matching marketplace; serves homeowners and contractors, not travelers or short-term stays."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billboards, rural broadband and insurance; no overlap with travel booking, rentals or experiences."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates casinos earning gaming wagers; does not run a booking marketplace for stays or experiences."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer experience and tech services for enterprises; not a consumer travel marketplace."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Organizes B2B trade shows earning booth fees from exhibitors; different customers and revenue model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency and media buying for brands; no travel marketplace or consumer booking overlap."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Leases office buildings to corporate tenants on long-term leases; no consumer travel or marketplace activity."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels earning room revenue directly; differs from Airbnb's host-supplied marketplace and booking fees."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Marketing, advertising and PR agency services for brands; unrelated to travel booking or rentals."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases select-service hotels with rooms sold directly; asset-owning lodging, not a multi-host marketplace."}]}
